belief_update: I worry that people might think I'm weak for needing reassurance, but I also know that's not who I am. I don't tell my boss or coworkers about my anxiety because I'm afraid they'll see me as unreliable, even though I haven't missed work or messed up anything at the job. I still apologize to my boyfriend when I check in too much, even though he doesn't make it a big deal. Some days I feel like hiding it is the only way to keep things from falling apart, and other days I wonder if I'm just making it harder for myself by not talking about it. I can talk about it with my sister and boyfriend, but I don't know if they see me the same way if they knew how much I keep it inside. I don't know if I'm worth less because of it, but I know I don't want to let it define me.
